item.title: Refugee-focused impact investment vehicle backs Kenyan water and recycling company | Impact Investor
item.description: The Refugee Investment Facility (RIF), a joint initiative between impact investment management and advisory firm iGravity and the Danish Refugee Council (DRC), has invested into LIFTA Kenya (LIFTA), an integrated bottled water and PET recycling company, based in Kakuma, Turkana County in northwestern Kenya.

item.title: Impact Investor Forum: One week to go | Impact Investor
item.description: Impact as a driver of portfolio resilience: Join us at The Conduit in London’s Covent Garden on Thursday 14 May to learn from key investors as they discuss how impact strategies can strengthen portfolios and contribute to long-term stability.

item.title: UK’s Better Futures Fund moves step closer to first funding round | Impact Investor
item.description: The £500m fund is due to open for project bids later in the year.

item.title: IFC, ILX provide $40m financing for Uruguayan sustainable wood products firm | Impact Investor
item.description: The funding will allow Arboreal to meet growing regional demand for sustainably-sourced wood from the construction industry.

item.title: New partnership delivers ‘most expansive’ Nature Positive Initiative pilot globally | Impact Investor
item.description: New Forests, a Sydney-based investment manager focused on nature-based solutions, has announced the delivery of what it describes as the world’s "most expansive" Nature Positive Initiative (NPI) pilot project.

item.title: Inside the Dutch pension system’s push to scale impact | Impact Investor
item.description: Dutch pension funds are scaling impact investing but allocations still lag behind targets. The challenge is no longer conviction, but building the governance, mandates and investable pipeline needed to deploy capital at the scale large schemes require.

item.title: Adenia Partners completes $180m first close for African SME-focused fund | Impact Investor
item.description: Adenia Partners has raised $180m at first close for its entrepreneurial fund, exceeding its target and signalling strong investor demand for strategies backing underserved small and mid-sized African businesses with growth and impact potential.

item.title: World Water Day: The flow of capital | Impact Investor
item.description: Marking World Water Day, investors and industry leaders highlight a widening financing gap and growing opportunities to back more efficient, resilient water systems.

item.title: Mexican biogas firm secures funding to scale methane-cutting platform for farmers | Impact Investor
item.description: The Mexican biogas company has raised $53m for FarmCarbon, a climate finance vehicle that channels carbon market revenues to smallholder farmers.

item.title: Institutional investment models worsening housing and climate crisis, report finds | Impact Investor
item.description: Institutional investment is transforming Europe’s housing landscape. A new report warns that prevailing strategies may intensify affordability challenges and stall climate progress, calling on impact investors to focus on generating tangible social and environmental benefits.

item.title: Swedish SME business accelerator launches to bolster Ukrainian partnerships | Impact Investor
item.description: Swedish DFI Swedfund has announced the launch of the Swedfund Business Accelerator aimed at supporting Swedish small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in establishing and expanding business partnerships in Ukraine.

item.title: Indian affordable housing provider secures major investment boost | Impact Investor
item.description: London-based LeapFrog Investments (LeapFrog) has participated in a $96m (€82.8m] funding round led by Malay private equity firm Creador into Shubham Housing Development Finance (Shubham), an Indian affordable housing finance provider. Other unnamed investors also participated.

item.title: Triodos wins £50m investing challenge with future generations focus | Impact Investor
item.description: A panel of young adults played a central role in deciding which of the finalists’ social and environmental impact strategies best reflected their own priorities.

item.title: Viewpoint: Ocean risks are rising. Can blue finance scale in time? | Impact Investor
item.description: As ocean risks begin to surface across assets and supply chains, the window to act is narrowing. Markets will pay for ocean risk. The question is whether investors will pay early or late, says Monty Simus.

item.title: New report urges corporates to play active role in social impact | Impact Investor
item.description: The report by the Macquarie Group Foundation says corporates have a role in enabling social impact through catalytic capital and partnerships with intermediaries.
